_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}, playing {num_rounds} rounds of Iterated Ultimatum Game.
You have ${pool} to split this round between yourself and Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Make an offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - If accepted → You get $(pool - X), other player gets $X
  - If rejected → Both get $0
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'I think this is fair. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decide on the offer with either [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Example: 'That seems reasonable. [Accept]'
            'Too unfair. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Kalo {round_number} bilibila! ---
Kɛlɛmɛ {proposer_id} ye kɛlɛmɛ tɛmɛ, Kɛlɛmɛ {responder_id} ye kɛlɛmɛ pɔɔrɛ.
round.offer: Kalo {round_number}: Kɛlɛmɛ {proposer_id} fɔ {offer} dɔla Kɛlɛmɛ {responder_id} (kɛlɛmɛ kɛndɛ ${keep}).
round.accepted: Pɩyɛ {responder_id} accepted! Round {round_number} gains: Pɩyɛ {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pɩyɛ {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. New totals: Pɩyɛ 0: ${total_0}, Pɩyɛ 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Kɛlɛmɛ {responder_id} pɔɔrɛ tɛmɛ lɛmɛ kɛlɛmɛ fɔɔ! Kalo {round_number} mɛrɛ: Kɛlɛmɛ wɛɛla +$0. Kɛlɛmɛ tɔpɛɛla wɛɛla: Kɛlɛmɛ 0: ${total_0}, Kɛlɛmɛ 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Sẽn dat n maan b tʋʋma segdame tɩ b kõ-a noor ne [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Sẽn na n yɩlẽ tɩ b paam ligdã, yaa tɩlae t'a ra zĩnd lɛɛr a yembr pʋgẽ ye.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sõngrã segd n yɩɩ $0 ne ${pool} sʋka.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: B pa kõ tõnd bũmb sẽn na yɩl tɩ d leok ye.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder bɛ [Accept] bee [Reject] kɛ offer ŋɔ.

outcome.win: Kɛlɛmɛ {winner} pɛɛra kɛlɛmɛ ${winner_total} tɔpɛɛla Kɛlɛmɛ {loser} tɔpɛɛla ${loser_total}.
